[STATE_CHECKPOINT]
COMPLETED: Extracted verbatim sentences for all six questions from the two provided sources. Identified effective date, duration, scope, paused activities, purpose, and exemptions. Noted discrepancy between press release (12 months) and ordinance (6 months).
REMAINING: Need to resolve which duration (12 months per press release vs 6 months per ordinance text) to report, and confirm whether scope includes incorporated municipalities.
DECISIONS: Will report duration as "six (6) months" per the ordinance text (ORD-2026-____) since that is the specific legal instrument, but note the 12-month press release context. Scope will be reported as "countywide" based on the ordinance's "Washington County" language, though the press release does not explicitly exclude municipalities.
CONTEXT: Effective date: 2026-06-30. Duration: six (6) months per ordinance, twelve (12) months per press release. Scope: Washington County per ordinance language. Paused activities: acceptance, processing, reviewing, and approval of all applications, plans, or requests for Data Centers. Exemption: does not apply to uses currently permitted with Certificate of Use & Occupancy disseminated as of effective date. Purpose: to study data centers in light of changing consumer demand and changes to existing infrastructure to evaluate suitability and economic, social and environmental risks.
